newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Tuesday on some late local selling interest, and despite higher Japanese prices, brokers said.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to the absence of fresh incentives. But prices were marked down sharply in the afternoon on some speculative selling interest. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.

"The absence of enquiries by the Chinese players and the big boys limited market activity. Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were a little firmer today but there was no follow-through buying interest here," another local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, August RSS3 fell 1.75 cents to 99.50 U.S. cents a kg.
August RSS1 also fell 1.75 cents to 142.75 Singapore cents (US$1.00) a kg.
August TSR20 fell 2.50 cents to 134.00 Singapore cents (US$0.94) a kg.
